summary: Bragg Gaming Group filed a Form 6-K announcing completion of its acquisition of Drayton International for aggregate consideration of US$9,000,000, satisfied through issuance of 4,500,000 common shares. Concurrently, 751,445 subscription receipts from a private placement at US$1.73 per receipt converted into common shares and warrants (exercise price US$2.16, 36-month term), and Bragg renewed its senior credit facility. Certain Drayton shareholders are subject to a 24-month lock-up with phased releases. The deal expands Bragg into U.S. ADW and sports betting markets. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium details were disclosed. Watch for integration milestones and lock-up expirations.
